audio_unit.note: `scripts/audit_manifest.py --pack toneking_x` reads the plugin's XML state; 97 keys reach the 97 published controls, the other two being host-only Preset Previous/Next actions. EQ HPF and Reverb Pre-Delay sit at their floor in the default state, so `values` probes settled them. Presets are not rendered through this edition: renders stay on the original plugin.

custom_ir.note: What --strip-irs clears. The path is the file, `selector` at `custom` makes the cab play it and `flag` says the side uses a file. The selector goes back to `default`, what a fresh plugin and Default.xml hold on that side (Dynamic 57 E33 left, Ribbon 121 E33 right). No X factory preset uses an IR, so `custom` comes from probing the selector and `flag` from X's key name; neither has been seen on a real file.

description: Parameter facts for Neural DSP Tone King Imperial MKII X, whose presets are Morgan-style text values in named sections, not the original's binary records. It contains no Neural DSP code, audio or preset content. Controls here were mapped against the running plugin, and every factory preset held by both editions supplied the conversions in the notes.

/selectedAmp.note: Moves no published control; the channel is ampParameters/ampChannel.
